next.reason: 1985: on a file attribute conflict, 'A USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure, if any, associated with the file-name is executed.' 2023 keeps this for an OPEN that fails with 39 (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR10; GR25 d) 'Any applicable USE FOR EXCEPTION or USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure is executed'; selection by §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3 and GR6). But it adds a case where the procedure is not executed: an OPEN inside an exception-checking PERFORM with an applicable WHEN phrase continues by that phrase and 'No applicable USE declarative is executed' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR25 c). 1985 refuses that program and 2023 accepts it with a different effect: a case added.
